title: Do Not Slop Project · Six web flow presets
status: Independent design proposals; owner review pending
persistence: Memory in this tab only. Example switching and in-app Back preserve intended state. Reload clears all local changes.
reset: Reset this example opens an explicit guard, restores only that fixture, clears local edits/outcomes, and leaves other examples unchanged.
standards_note: WCAG 2.2 AA target size minimum is 24×24 CSS px with stated exceptions including spacing. 44×44 is the enhanced AAA criterion. Our 44/46/56px hit-area proposals are not universal WCAG requirements; no conformance certification is claimed. Browser Tab does not adopt Xbox controller wrapping.

presets.label: Shopping
presets.visitor_intent: Compare two objects, choose a finish, and review quantities and costs.
main_path: list: compare two products
product: choose a finish; Add to cart
cart: quantity 1–5, remove/undo
review: inspect amounts; Finish local review
presets.layout_family: Two-column product catalog; split product detail; line-item cart and receipt.
presets.inappropriate_when: A large marketplace needs search, stock and fulfillment rules. This small catalog does not represent checkout.

menu.density: Two top-level shop destinations; two finish options; quantity controls stay with each line.

routes.back: Product → collection; review → cart; cart → collection.
routes.cancel: Removal has Undo last removal; no purchase cancellation exists.
routes.exit: Choose another example; cart and finish selections remain in memory.
routes.browser_back: Restores prior stage with the current cart. A stale review route with an empty cart becomes cart.

states.empty: Remove every line → Your cart is empty → Browse objects.
states.error: Adding beyond 5 per finish announces the limit; current cart retained.
states.recovery: Undo last removal once; repeated undo does not add another item.
states.loading_scope: Not represented: local synchronous operations; no synthetic spinner/latency.

selection.additional_signal: aria-pressed or current label where applicable

dimensions.classification: Context-specific design proposals; rendered measurements are separate below.

proposals.density: Two top-level shop destinations; two finish options; quantity controls stay with each line.

presets.label: Information
presets.visitor_intent: Find one short entry and return to the same search context.
main_path: results: enter query and choose topic; Search
article: read sections
return: same query/topic/results, focus and list scroll
presets.layout_family: Search/filter rail and editorial result index; narrow reading page.
presets.inappropriate_when: Long technical documentation may need a persistent section tree. This short handbook is not current legal or safety guidance.

menu.density: Two search controls and one submit; two short article section links only when reading.

mobile.search_columns: query spans full row; topic and submit share next row

routes.back: Return to results restores committed query/topic and result-link focus; in-app return restores list scroll.
routes.cancel: Clear search & filters returns the full fixture; no deletion.
routes.exit: Choose another example; committed search and current article remain.
routes.browser_back: Article → results keeps committed query/topic. Scroll restoration is browser-managed for browser Back, explicitly restored for in-app Return.

states.empty: Search “zzzz” → No entries match → Clear search & filters.
states.recovery: Clear query and topic; focus Search entries.
states.loading_scope: Not represented: local synchronous operations; no synthetic spinner/latency.

roles.destructive_usage: Only explicit example reset in shared guard

presets.label: Course
presets.visitor_intent: Understand an axis label, try one question, then continue.
main_path: lesson 1: read axis label
practice: select a native radio answer; Check answer
feedback: wrong → Try again or Revisit lesson; correct → Continue to lesson 2
lesson 2: read comparison; Finish lesson
presets.layout_family: Course outline beside a reading/practice workspace; native outline disclosure on narrow screens.
presets.inappropriate_when: One answer is not a mastery measure. This pattern does not cover exam timing, graded submissions or video players.

menu.density: Two outline entries; lesson 2 disabled until lesson 1 passed. Mobile native disclosure can reopen.

routes.back: Practice/feedback → lesson without clearing answer or attempts.
routes.cancel: No submitted grading record or external enrollment to cancel.
routes.exit: Choose another example; lesson, attempts and completion retained.
routes.browser_back: Earlier course stage keeps current local learning state; invalid old practice routes on lesson 2 become lesson.

states.empty: No response selected: Check answer disabled.
states.error: Incorrect is learning feedback, not a system error.
states.recovery: Try again clears response/feedback only; attempts retained. Revisit lesson preserves feedback.
states.loading_scope: Not represented: local synchronous operations; no synthetic spinner/latency.

selection.additional_signal: Native checked radio + Selected text; Current/Completed labels

roles.destructive_usage: Only explicit example reset in shared guard

presets.label: Community
presets.visitor_intent: Read a conversation and inspect a private local reply draft.
main_path: topic rows: select thread; optional channel filter
thread: read original post
draft: write local reply; Preview draft
preview: Edit draft, Keep draft locally or Cancel draft
presets.layout_family: Topic rows and a compact channel rail; linear thread, separate editor and preview.
presets.inappropriate_when: Live communities require moderation, identity, abuse handling and server-side drafts. This example never posts.

menu.density: Three channel filters plus topic rows; no feed metrics, notifications or account menu.

routes.back: Thread → Topics; preview → Edit draft retains text.
routes.cancel: Unsaved reply changes → guard → discard to prior local draft or keep editing.
routes.exit: Dirty draft triggers guard on example switch, browser Back, or Cancel; reload/close uses browser beforeunload when supported.
routes.browser_back: Guard prevents loss. Canceling a Back attempt restores current route with pushState; the browser forward branch can change.

states.empty: Empty reply → Enter a reply before previewing.
states.error: Whitespace-only preview has associated error and aria-invalid; text preserved.
states.recovery: Type a reply; Preview. Guard Keep editing preserves raw text.
states.loading_scope: Not represented: local synchronous operations; no synthetic spinner/latency.

selection.additional_signal: aria-pressed or current label where applicable

roles.destructive_usage: Discard actual unsaved changes in guard

presets.label: Work
presets.visitor_intent: Find a task, change its saved fields, and return without losing other records.
main_path: register: status filter; choose task
detail: read fields and notes
edit: title/owner/status/notes
Save task → same record detail; Cancel edit → prior saved record
presets.layout_family: Compact project rail and task register; factual detail and labeled form.
presets.inappropriate_when: Multi-user concurrent editing needs versioning and conflict recovery. This page only edits memory in one tab.

menu.density: One actual project destination and three filter values; register rows expose title/ID/owner/due/status.

routes.cancel: Cancel edit or Escape discards only the open edit and retains original record.
routes.exit: Changed edit triggers guard before switching examples or browser Back; other records retained.
routes.browser_back: Returns through prior stages; an edit route without an active draft becomes detail.

states.error: Empty/whitespace title → Enter a task title; owner/status/notes retained.

presets.label: Booking
presets.visitor_intent: Choose a suitable space and an available time, inspect terms, and recover from a stale slot.
main_path: space/capacity: Small room or Quiet desk
date/time: select available slot; meeting name and people
review: exact date/time/timezone/space/cost/terms
14:00 Small room confirm → conflict → choose 15:00 → review again
explicit local confirm → DEMO-B01
presets.layout_family: Service/capacity rail and date/time grid; separate booking review with all terms.
presets.inappropriate_when: Real booking requires authoritative availability, time-zone conversion, payment and cancellation handling. Synthetic availability is not a reservation guarantee.

menu.density: No month browser or fictitious calendar days; only two fixture dates and available times.

routes.back: Review/conflict → space & time retains meeting/name/people/selected date.
routes.cancel: Change session edits selections; no actual booking cancellation exists.
routes.exit: Choose another example; local inputs and confirmation remain until changed/reset/reload.
routes.browser_back: Previous stage keeps current inputs; stale selection stays explicitly unavailable and cannot be confirmed.

states.empty: October 16 has no times → Next available date: Oct 15; selection stays empty.
states.error: Blank meeting name or people outside space capacity; values preserved. Small room 14:00 becomes stale at confirm.
states.recovery: Conflict shows attempted 14:00, retained details and Choose 15:00; returns to review without automatic confirmation.
states.loading_scope: Not represented: local synchronous operations; no synthetic spinner/latency.

selection.additional_signal: Selected text + aria-pressed; native radio for service

roles.destructive_usage: Only explicit example reset in shared guard; no cancel-reservation control
